title: Research: exact two-role GL3 coordinate-CNOT minimum for one target
body:
## Result

For the fixed target `A = T12 T13 T21` in `GL_3(F2)`, the exact minimum is six paid coordinate-CNOT calls to realize `diag([A],[A])` with exactly two scalar registers, arbitrary free scalar `GL_2(F2)` basis mixing, and no other address labels. The direct word uses six calls. Exact formal-group-algebra search finds no word through five.

This is one scoped higher-dimensional instance of the open branch listed in `research/coordinate-cnot-register-bound`. It is not a general three-dimensional sharing theorem, a physical bit-supplier change, or a new `κ`.

## Evidence

- Exact `GL_3(F2)` Cayley BFS: 168 address matrices; `rank(A-I)=2`; shortest coordinate-CNOT word length 3, layers `[1,6,24,51,60,24,2]`.
- Full two-role alphabet: six CNOT labels times all six rank-one idempotents on `F2^2`, for 36 paid factor types.
- In `F2[GL_3(F2)]`, the radius-2 prefix ball has 961 states and the radius-3 suffix ball 22,073 states. All prefix residual lookups miss, covering every word of length at most five. Exact direct replay gives the six-call upper bound.
- Sparse generic matrix-product cross-check: 252 factor updates. Six direct-word omissions and a wrong-label mutation fail; one-copy and expanded-alphabet controls pass.
- Local CPython 3.14.7 normal and optimized replays agree. Package source-pin check passes. The registered Python 3.12 package runner could not run locally because Python 3.12 is not installed; the direct verifier is registered for CI.

## Scope and cost

The broad binary-affine rank-priced model gives an optimistic floor of four calls for two copies from total displacement rank four. This coordinate-CNOT alphabet's direct cost is six. The tested five-call saving does not occur for this fixed target. The selected complex supplier remains binding; no supplier integration, selected cold replay, or `κ` change is claimed.

## Reproduction

```sh
python3 -I -B research/gl3-coordinate-cnot-pair-seed1385e243/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/gl3-coordinate-cnot-pair-seed1385e243/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/gl3-coordinate-cnot-pair-seed1385e243 --check-only
```

Expected conclusion: `exact_two_register_minimum=6 no_word_through=5 selected_kappa_unchanged`.
